CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the content's presentation found.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) and an explicit origin/presentation status are both present and separably recorded for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the same content's presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify content labels (red/blue) with coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Identification (color/coords) and a separate origin/presentation status are both explicitly recorded for the same content.

O.rationale: Explicit origin fields describe how content is represented/accessible; display orientation statement describes presentation properties.
